This individual was the '''Imperial sector governor''' of the [[Lahara sector/Legends|Lahara sector]] during the early portion of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. This [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] paid a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], including the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], in advance for the capture of a group of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]], including [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], who were attempting to set up a safe colony on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Gandolo IV/Legends|Gandolo IV]]. Bossk's group ultimately failed to capture the fugitive Wookiees.

==Behind the scenes==
In each source in which this character is referenced, the character is only referred to ambiguously as the Imperial governor of the sector in which Gandolo IV is located. The [[2009]] release of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' confirms Gandolo IV to be located in the Lahara sector, and so this article asserts that this character is the Imperial governor of the Lahara sector.

The [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|PC game]] [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] places Gandolo IV in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]], which has since been overridden by ''The Essential Atlas'' and its related online content on [[StarWars.com]]. Therefore, this character should not be mistaken as the Imperial governor of the Moddell sector.
